description.value: BC-based ride-hailing app covering communities where Uber doesn't operate, including Squamish, Whistler, Tofino, Ucluelet, and Nanaimo. Some drivers have bike racks — use the filter in the app to add the number of bikes to your request. For drivers without a rack, whether a bike fits depends on the vehicle; you may need to remove a wheel or partially disassemble. See coastalrides.ca/blog/sunshine-coast-bike-road-trip for an example of the service in action.

Accommodates bicycles.detail: Shuttle vehicles carry bikes - blog: 'send lap after lap, thanks to our shuttle service and handy bike rack'; can transport riders from the ferry terminal to the trailhead and coast-wide incl. Texada
